lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity, forming a rectilinear grid. The high-luminance blobs are precisely centered at the intersection nodes of these bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity peaking on the upper edge and casting a dark shadow immediately below, creating a linear feature set parallel to the primary axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated toward the posterior margin and apex of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three deep, parallel diagonal grooves are visible on the posterior lateral flank near the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a distinct shadow gradient suggesting structural indentation. Additionally, multiple small, elongated white silhouettes (likely remoras) are attached near the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank.
